title: Each bell ringer controls one bell with one rope, in time with the others
alt: Bell ropes hanging in a stone-walled tower room, each with a striped blue and yellow woollen grip.

posts.facebook:
Tower bell ringing is a team activity. The Association of Ringing Teachers says it takes on average 10 to 15 hours of intensive instruction to ring a bell safely and well. Find a tower near you, in the UK or North America, and ask for a first handling lesson.

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/learn-to-ring-church-bells/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
